title: highentDCA: entropy-based decimation for maximum-entropy Direct Coupling Analysis models
description: Python implementation of the entropy-based decimation procedure used to identify maximum-entropy Direct Coupling Analysis models (meDCA) along a sparse Potts-model training trajectory. The command-line interface exposes a single training workflow, highentDCA train, which runs the edDCA decimation procedure: it starts from a fully connected bmDCA model, progressively removes the least statistically significant couplings, estimates the model entropy by thermodynamic integration at prescribed coupling-density checkpoints, and stores the resulting trajectory. The package builds on adabmDCA for Boltzmann-machine training, Monte Carlo sampling, and model I/O.
